corpus.honesty: Incidence is over the corpus actually loaded. reconstructed-catalog-contract means the Windows harness-restore registries were absent; counts match the published 284/108 contract; this is not a live-registry read.

extraction.empty_policy: zero extractable mechanisms => [] , never a default id
extraction.unmapped_policy: vocabulary-gap, never a free-text fallback id

incidence.per_cell_rule: cell (artifact, mechanism) is 1 iff an impl_needle of that mechanism occurs in the artifact's definition fields

question: Which canonical mechanisms does each of the 284 candidates and 108 blueprints actually implement — extracted from its definition rather than from its self-description — and what is the resulting mechanism-by-artifact incidence matrix?

records.definition: Raters produce a first score without seeing other raters' scores or a shared transcript.
records.discriminating_example: independent-rating stage; scores without seeing other ballots
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:blind-independent-first-pass iff one of ['blind independent first pass', 'scores without seeing other', 'independent-rating'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: Agents read a shared transcript and update a joint position; later speakers see earlier speakers.
records.discriminating_example: shared-deliberation stage with a common transcript
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:shared-context-deliberation iff one of ['shared transcript deliberation', 'shared-deliberation', 'joint position from a common transcript'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: The same pinned inputs and seed yield byte-identical outputs; replay is a function, not a resample.
records.discriminating_example: deterministic-replay stage; same seed same bytes
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:deterministic-replay iff one of ['byte-identical replay', 'deterministic-replay', 'same pinned inputs and seed yield byte-identical'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: A sampling step draws from a distribution; repeats need not match.
records.discriminating_example: stochastic-sample stage; temperature sampling
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:nondeterministic-sampling iff one of ['temperature sampling draw', 'stochastic-sample', 'draws from a distribution'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: Work is dispatched without waiting for the worker's result at the call site.
records.discriminating_example: fire-forget-dispatch stage; no join at caller
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:fire-and-forget-dispatch iff one of ['dispatch without waiting', 'fire-forget-dispatch', 'no join at the call site'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: A join waits for every dispatched branch before the next stage.
records.discriminating_example: blocking-fan-in stage; wait-for-all barrier
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:blocking-fan-in-barrier iff one of ['wait-for-all barrier', 'blocking-fan-in', 'join waits for every dispatched branch'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: Stop is an evaluable expression over run state, not free-text advice.
records.discriminating_example: typed-stop-eval stage; max_stages compiled to a predicate
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:typed-stopping-rule iff one of ['evaluable stop expression', 'typed-stop-eval', 'stop compiles to a predicate'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: Judges are denied author identity or other specified fields before scoring.
records.discriminating_example: info-partition stage; author id stripped before score
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:information-partition iff one of ['author identity stripped', 'info-partition', 'denied author identity'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: Every node carries a dereferenceable source anchor (commit, URL, file:line).
records.discriminating_example: provenance-pin stage; commit SHA plus file:line
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:provenance-anchor iff one of ['dereferenceable source anchor', 'provenance-pin', 'commit sha plus file:line'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: A stage blocks until a named human role records an accept or reject.
records.discriminating_example: human-gate stage; owner accept required
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:human-checkpoint iff one of ['blocks until a named human', 'human-gate', 'owner accept required'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: Failed stages may rerun; a second success is observationally equal to the first.
records.discriminating_example: idempotent-retry stage; replay-safe on failure
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:idempotent-retry iff one of ['replay-safe on failure', 'idempotent-retry', 'second success is observationally equal'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

records.definition: A fused workflow can be decomposed back into the source component id set.
records.discriminating_example: fusion-decompose stage; recover source ids
records.extraction_rule: credit mech:fusion-decompose iff one of ['decomposed back into the source', 'fusion-decompose', 'recover source component ids'] occurs in definition fields (does, stages, gates, stop, code); do not credit prose self-description or notes mentions

reviewer.method: re-run definition extractor on a planted documenter that mentions a blocking fan-in barrier but implements only a human checkpoint; both-states: include_notes=True must credit the barrier, include_notes=False must not

sample_30.sampling_rule: first two candidates of each of 9 families (18) plus first twelve blueprints in id order (12); frozen before extraction

vocabulary.collision_rule: mech: prefix is disjoint from wf-, bp-, opt-, and catalog unit ids
